multi_entity_note: Two parties, PFS Funds (the Trust) and Potomac Fund Management, Inc. (the Adviser), plus four named funds.
processing_note: A copy of the Agreement and Declaration of Trust is on file with the Secretary of State of Massachusetts.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and section 9 call it the Services Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is dated as of June 24, 2020; the second occurrence dates the separate Management Agreement.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Section 9 says the term begins on the date of execution.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is stated only as two years, not as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 11 applies the laws of the State of Massachusetts; the other occurrences are the trust's domicile and filing office.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: After the two-year term the agreement continues from year to year if approved annually.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The 60-day notice is for termination at any time, not a notice to prevent renewal.
